mapper.select: SELECT user_code, nickname, name, email, birth, gender, phone, status FROM tbl_user WHERE user_code = CAST(#{userCode} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_user SET nickname = #{userDTO.nickname}, name = #{userDTO.name}, birth = #{userDTO.birth}, gender = #{userDTO.gender}, phone = #{userDTO.phone} WHERE user_code = CAST(#{userCode} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(store_code) FROM store WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS greenfireCount, (SELECT count(challenge_part_code) FROM challenge_part WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS challengeCount, (SELECT count(post_code) FROM post WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS feedCount, (SELECT count(target_user) FROM user_follows WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS friendCount

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ch.challenge_code as challengeCode, ch.challenge_title as challengeTitle, ch.challenge_content, ch.thumbnail_url as thumbnail, COUNT(*) OVER() AS totalCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ch.created_at) AS rn FROM challenge_part cp LEFT JOIN challenge ch ON cp.challenge_code = ch.challenge_code WHERE cp.user_code = #{userCode} ) t WHERE t.rn <= 3
